article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Ty Robinson’s 18 points helped Central Arkansas defeat Jacksonville 82-67 on Saturday. Robinson shot 6 for 16 (2 for 10 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Bears (3-3). Luke Moore scored 13 points while shooting 3 for 7 from beyond the arc and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line. R.J. Young shot 3 of 3 from the field and 4 for 5 from the line to finish with 10 points. Hayden Wood led the way for the Dolphins (2-4) with 24 points. Jacksonville also got 21 points, 11 rebounds and five assists from Jamie Phillips Jr. Evan Sterck finished with seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
